sys_update_xml.name: sys_ws_operation_e17c1e6373fbc354ed3bfa714ab8b768
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>companion</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {
    // GET /companion - the companion document (field map, no person) of the published generation; 503 when none.
    var r;
    try {
        r = new LucairnCompanionPublisher().companion();
    } catch (e) {
        r = { status: 503, body: { error: 'no_companion' } };
    }
    response.setStatus(r.status);
    response.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    response.setHeader('Pragma', 'no-cache');
    if (r.text === undefined) {
        response.setBody(r.body);
        return;
    }
    // The document is written once, as text, in the platform's usual {"result": ...} envelope.
    response.setContentType('application/json');
    response.getStreamWriter().writeString('{"result":' + r.text + '}');
})(request, response);

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1620539_lucdir.LucairnFieldMapDerivation</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Lucairn directory companion (see the package README).</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LucairnFieldMapDerivation</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/*
 * LucairnFieldMapDerivation - from the instance's dictionary rows and table
 * rows to the companion document's people_tables and field_map (tier 1).
 *
 * The rules are those of the design note "the field-map derivation -
 * rules, decision table, totals" (version recorded in
 * vectors/DERIVATION_SOURCE.md). The names in the comments (N1-N5, T1-T7,
 * D0-D13, W1-W3, S) are that document's. tests/field_map_derivation_reference.py
 * is an independent Python twin; the vectors compare the two byte for byte.
 *
 *   derive(dictionaryRows, tableRows, settings)
 *       -> { people_tables: [...], field_map: {...}, report: {...} }
 *       or { fatal: [word, detail] }             never both, never a partial map
 *   peopleChecks(people_tables, field_map)

        peopleTables.sort(compareCodeUnits);
        peopleTables.unshift('sys_user');
        for (i = 0; i < verdicts.length; i++) {
            verdict = verdicts[i][1];
            if (verdict === '') {
                rec = tables[byName[verdicts[i][0]]];
                if (rec.sharedParent) verdict = 'shared_parent';
                else if (rec.below) verdict = 'covered_by_accepted_parent';
            }
            if (verdict !== '') verdicts[i] = ['people_table', verdicts[i][0], verdict];
            else verdicts[i] = null;
        }
        for (j = 0; j < order.length; j++) {
            rec = tables[order[j]];
            rec.people = rec.family || rec.accepted || (rec.parent >= 0 && tables[rec.parent].people);
            if (rec.people) for (k = order[j]; k >= 0 && !tables[k].having; k = tables[k].parent) tables[k].having = true;
        }

        /* ---- T5: the label columns L */
        for (i = 0; i < SEVEN.length; i++) {
            name = SEVEN[i][0];
            found = 0;
            usable = 0;
            for (j = 0; j < userLine.length; j++) {
                rec = tables[userLine[j]];
                if (!own.call(rec.fields, name)) continue;
                found++;
                if (usableLabel(rec.fields[name])) usable++;
            }
            if (found === 0 || usable !== found) return { fatal: ['label_column_unusable', name] };
            labelKind[name] = SEVEN[i][1];
            labelColumns.push([name, SEVEN[i][1]]);
        }
        /* per field name, what the tables of F and above sys_user hold: read once, asked per admin name */
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
            rec = tables[i];
            if (!(rec.family || rec.aboveUser)) continue;
            for (j = 0; j < rec.elements.length; j++) {
                f = rec.fields[rec.elements[j]];
                if (!own.call(familyFields, f.element)) familyFields[f.element] = { usable: 0, allEmail: true, allPhone: true };
                if (!usableLabel(f)) continue;
                info = familyFields[f.element];
                info.usable++;
                if (!has(T_EMAIL, f.type)) info.allEmail = false;
                if (!has(T_PHONE, f.type)) info.allPhone = false;
            }
        }
        list = items(settings, 'admin_label_columns');
        seen = {};
        for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            name = list[i];
            if (name === null) {                                  // E3: an item that is no text
                refusals.push(['label_column', '', 'bad_name']);
                continue;
            }
            verdict = '';
            if (!RE_COLUMN.test(name)) verdict = 'bad_name';
            else if (RE_DIGIT.test(name)) verdict = 'has_digit';      // erratum v2.1: no digit in a label's word part
            else if (own.call(seen, name)) verdict = 'listed_twice';
            else if (isSeven(name)) verdict = 'one_of_the_seven';
            else if (name.indexOf('sys_') === 0) verdict = 'system_field';
            else {
                for (j = 0; j < REFUSED_WORDS.length; j++) if (name.indexOf(REFUSED_WORDS[j]) >= 0) verdict = 'refused_word';
            }
            if (verdict === '') {
                info = own.call(familyFields, name) ? familyFields[name] : null;
                if (info === null) verdict = 'not_a_user_family_field';
                else if (info.usable === 0) verdict = 'wrong_type';
                else if (adminColumns.length >= MAX_ADMIN_LABEL_COLUMNS) verdict = 'too_many';
                else {
                    labelKind[name] = info.allEmail ? 'email' : (info.allPhone ? 'phone' : 'other');
                    adminColumns.push(name);
                }
            }
            if (RE_COLUMN.test(name)) seen[name] = true;
            if (verdict !== '') refusals.push(['label_column', name, verdict]);
        }
        adminColumns.sort(compareCodeUnits);
        for (i = 0; i < adminColumns.length; i++) labelColumns.push([adminColumns[i], labelKind[adminColumns[i]]]);
        for (i = 0; i < verdicts.length; i++) if (verdicts[i] !== null) refusals.push(verdicts[i]);

        /* ---- T6: the leave-out list. E1: a named table and every readable table below it. */
        list = items(settings, 'leave_out_tables');
        seen = {};
        for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            name = list[i];
            if (name === null) {                                  // E3: an item that is no text
                refusals.push(['leave_out', '', 'bad_name']);
                continue;
            }
            rec = isCarried(name) && own.call(byName, name) ? tables[byName[name]] : null;
            if (!isCarried(name)) verdict = 'bad_name';
            else if (own.call(seen, name)) verdict = 'listed_twice';
            else if (rec === null) verdict = 'not_in_table_list';
            else if (rec.state !== READABLE) verdict = 'parent_unreadable';
            else if (rec.having) verdict = 'people_table';
            else {
                verdict = '';
                rec.named = true;
            }
            if (isCarried(name)) seen[name] = true;
            if (verdict !== '') refusals.push(['leave_out', name, verdict]);
        }

        /* ---- E1, T7, W3: left out or written; possible people tables; `super` */
        for (j = 0; j < order.length; j++) {
            rec = tables[order[j]];
            up = rec.parent >= 0 ? tables[rec.parent] : null;
            rec.leftOut = rec.named || (up !== null && up.leftOut);
            rec.written = !rec.leftOut;
            rec.refused = rec.sharedParent || (up !== null && up.refused);                 // T7r
            rec.marked = rec.marker || (up !== null && up.marked);                         // T7a (E5: by row)
            first = up !== null && up.first;                                               // T7b, T7c: the names on
            last = up !== null && up.last;                                                 // the table and above it
            full = up !== null && up.full;
            mail = up !== null && up.mail;
            for (k = 0; k < rec.elements.length; k++) {
                element = rec.elements[k];
                if (element.indexOf('u_') === 0) element = element.substring(2);          // ONE leading u_
                if (element === 'first_name') first = true;
                else if (element === 'last_name') last = true;
                else if (element === 'name') full = true;
                else if (element === 'email') mail = true;
            }
            rec.first = first;
            rec.last = last;
            rec.full = full;
            rec.mail = mail;
            rec.possible = !rec.having && (rec.refused || rec.marked || (first && last) || (full && mail));
            /* W3 with E1 and E2: `super` is the table's parent; null for a root and for a possible
             * people table. A written table's parent is written: a table below a left-out one is
             * left out itself, so nothing is ever re-pointed. */
            if (rec.written) {
                written++;
                rec.superName = up === null || rec.possible ? null : up.name;
            }
        }
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
            rec = tables[i];
            if (rec.state !== READABLE) {
                unreadable.push(rec.name);
                continue;
            }
            if (rec.having) having.push(rec.name);
            if (rec.leftOut) {
                leftOut.push(rec.name);
                leftOutNames[rec.name] = true;
            }
            if (rec.possible) {
                possible.push(rec.name);
                possibleNames[rec.name] = true;
            }
        }

        /* ---- D0 - D13: first hit wins */
        function judge(t, x) {
            var el = x.element, target;
            if (t.state !== READABLE) return 'parent_unreadable';
            if (t.leftOut) return 'left_out_by_admin';
            if (x.conflict) return 'duplicate_conflict';
            if (!x.active) return 'inactive_row';
            if (has(T_REF, x.type)) {
                target = isCarried(x.reference) && own.call(byName, x.reference) ? tables[byName[x.reference]] : null;
                if (target !== null && target.family) return ['ref_user', null];
            }
            if (has(T_DATE, x.type) && RE_BIRTH.test(el)) return ['birth', null];
            if (t.having) {
                if (!own.call(labelKind, el)) return 'people_table_default';
                return has(T_LABEL, x.type) ? ['identity', labelKind[el], el] : 'label_column_wrong_type';
            }
            if ((el === 'sys_created_by' || el === 'sys_updated_by') && x.type === 'string') return ['identity', 'login', 'user_name'];
            if (has(T_EMAIL, x.type)) return ['identity', 'email', 'email'];
            if (has(T_PHONE, x.type)) return ['identity', 'phone', 'phone'];
            if (RE_BIRTH.test(el)) return 'birth_name_not_a_date';
            if (has(T_REF, x.type)) return x.reference === '' ? 'reference_without_target' : 'reference_not_user';
            if (t.possible) return 'possible_people_table';
            if (has(T_CODE, x.type)) return ['code', null];
            if (has(T_PROSE, x.type)) return ['free', null];
            if (has(T_FIXED, x.type)) return ['fixed', null];
            if (x.type === 'string') return emitText ? ['text', null] : 'string';
            return 'type_not_named';
        }
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
            rec = tables[i];
            for (j = 0; j < rec.elements.length; j++) {
                f = rec.fields[rec.elements[j]];
                e = judge(rec, f);
                if (typeof e === 'string') f.reason = e;
                else f.entry = e;
            }
        }

        /* The field with the nearest entry for `el` on a table above t, or null: at most 32
         * steps. (Every table above a written table is written.) */
        function nearestEntry(t, el) {
            var q, x;
            for (q = t.parent; q >= 0; q = tables[q].parent) {
                x = tables[q].fields;
                if (own.call(x, el) && x[el].entry !== null) return x[el];
            }
            return null;
        }

        /* ---- W2a: one pass over the D results, on the dictionary chains */
        drop = [];
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
            rec = tables[i];
            if (!rec.written) continue;
            for (j = 0; j < rec.elements.length; j++) {
                f = rec.fields[rec.elements[j]];
                if (f.entry === null || has(HIDE, f.entry[0])) continue;
                for (k = rec.parent; k >= 0; k = tables[k].parent) {
                    up = tables[k].fields;
                    if (own.call(up, f.element) && up[f.element].entry !== null && !sameEntry(up[f.element].entry, f.entry)) {
                        drop.push(f);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (i = 0; i < drop.length; i++) {
            drop[i].entry = null;
            drop[i].reason = 'chain_conflict';
        }
        /* ---- W2b: to the fixed point. A hide entry is never removed. */
        do {
            changed = false;
            for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
                rec = tables[i];
                if (!rec.written) continue;
                for (j = 0; j < rec.elements.length; j++) {
                    f = rec.fields[rec.elements[j]];
                    if (f.entry !== null) continue;
                    up = nearestEntry(rec, f.element);
                    if (up !== null && !has(HIDE, up.entry[0])) {
                        up.entry = null;
                        up.reason = 'chain_conflict';
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        } while (changed);

        /* ---- E2, counted before anything is built. Per written table, from the parent's value
         * and one walk per own entry: hideSeen / plainSeen = the field names whose nearest entry
         * on the table or above it is of a hide / of another class. For a possible people table
         * that gives the entries it will hold as copies and n of possible_people_inherited. */
        for (j = 0; j < order.length; j++) {
            rec = tables[order[j]];
            if (!rec.written) continue;
            up = rec.parent >= 0 ? tables[rec.parent] : null;
            hide = up === null ? 0 : up.hideSeen;
            plain = up === null ? 0 : up.plainSeen;
            ownHide = 0;                                     // own entries under a hide entry above
            ownPlain = 0;                                    // own entries under an entry of another class above
            rec.hideOwn = [];
            for (k = 0; k < rec.elements.length; k++) {
                f = rec.fields[rec.elements[k]];
                if (f.entry === null) continue;
                isHide = has(HIDE, f.entry[0]);
                if (isHide) rec.hideOwn.push(f);
                prev = nearestEntry(rec, f.element);
                if (prev === null) {
                    if (isHide) hide++;
                    else plain++;
                } else if (has(HIDE, prev.entry[0])) {
                    ownHide++;
                    if (!isHide) {
                        hide--;
                        plain++;
                    }
                } else {
                    ownPlain++;
                    if (isHide) {
                        plain--;
                        hide++;
                    }
                }
            }
            rec.hideSeen = hide;
            rec.plainSeen = plain;
            if (rec.possible && up !== null) {
                copies += up.hideSeen - ownHide;
                rec.inheritCount = up.plainSeen - ownPlain;
            }
        }
        if (copies > MAX_COPIED_ENTRIES) return { fatal: ['input_not_readable', 'too_many_copied_entries'] };

        /* ---- the map. A possible people table (E2): its own entries are written (W1 does not
         * apply to it) and, for every field name it has no own entry for, the nearest hide entry
         * above is copied onto it; a copy is no input row and is not counted in `entries`.
         * Every other table: W1. */
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
            rec = tables[i];
            out = {};
            for (j = 0; j < rec.elements.length; j++) {
                f = rec.fields[rec.elements[j]];
                if (f.entry === null) {
                    unlisted[f.reason] += f.rows;
                    continue;
                }
                if (!rec.possible) {
                    up = nearestEntry(rec, f.element);
                    if (up !== null && sameEntry(up.entry, f.entry)) {
                        inheritedSame++;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                out[f.element] = f.entry.slice(0);
                entries[f.entry[0]]++;
            }
            if (!rec.written) continue;
            if (rec.possible) {
                for (k = rec.parent; k >= 0; k = tables[k].parent) {
                    list = tables[k].hideOwn;
                    for (j = 0; j < list.length; j++) if (!own.call(out, list[j].element)) out[list[j].element] = list[j].entry.slice(0);
                }
            }
            fieldMap[rec.name] = { 'super': rec.superName, fields: out };
        }

        /* ---- S, then the post-condition of the cut */
        reason = peopleReason(peopleTables, fieldMap);
        if (reason === '') reason = cutReason(fieldMap, possibleNames, leftOutNames);
        if (reason !== '') return { fatal: ['people_check_failed', reason] };

        /* ---- the report */
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
            rec = tables[i];
            if (rec.possible && rec.written && rec.inheritCount > 0) inherited.push([rec.name, rec.inheritCount]);
        }
        having.sort(compareCodeUnits);
        possible.sort(compareCodeUnits);
        unreadable.sort(compareCodeUnits);
        leftOut.sort(compareCodeUnits);
        inherited.sort(function(x, y) { return compareCodeUnits(x[0], y[0]); });
        notes.sort(comparePairs);
        return {
            people_tables: peopleTables,
            field_map: fieldMap,
            report: {
                rows_read: dictionaryRows.length, tables_read: tableRows.length, tables_written: written,
                tables_not_carried: tablesNotCarried, entries: entries, not_written: { inherited_same: inheritedSame },
                unlisted: unlisted, skipped: skipped, people_having: having, possible_people_tables: possible,
                tables_unreadable: unreadable, tables_left_out: leftOut, possible_people_inherited: inherited,
                label_columns: labelColumns, refusals: refusals, notes: notes
            }
        };
    }

    function isSeven(name) {
        var i;
        for (i = 0; i < SEVEN.length; i++) if (SEVEN[i][0] === name) return true;
        return false;
    }

    return {
        initialize: function() {
        },

        /* See the head of this file. Never throws: anything unexpected in the
         * inputs ends as { fatal: ['input_not_readable', ...] }, never as a map. */
        derive: function(dictionaryRows, tableRows, settings) {
            try {
                if (!isArray(dictionaryRows)) return { fatal: ['input_not_readable', 'dictionaryRows'] };
                if (!isArray(tableRows)) return { fatal: ['input_not_readable', 'tableRows'] };
                return run(dictionaryRows, tableRows, settings);
            } catch (e) {
                return { fatal: ['input_not_readable', 'exception'] };
            }
        },

        /* S as its own pure function: '' or the reason. Never throws, and never
         * answers '' for arguments whose shape it cannot walk. */
        peopleChecks: function(peopleTables, fieldMap) {
            try {
                if (!readable(peopleTables, fieldMap)) return 'map_not_readable';
                return peopleReason(peopleTables, fieldMap);
            } catch (e) {
                return 'map_not_readable';
            }
        },

        type: 'LucairnFieldMapDerivation'
    };
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>lucairn.runner</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-14 07:29:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>845c1a6373fbc354ed3bfa714ab8b740</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LucairnFieldMapDerivation</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Lucairn Directory Fingerprints" source="x_1620539_lucdir">41b040d773fb0354ed3bfa714ab8b787</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Lucairn Directory Fingerprints">41b040d773fb0354ed3bfa714ab8b787</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_845c1a6373fbc354ed3bfa714ab8b740</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>lucairn.runner</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-14 07:29:25</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1620539_lucdir.LucairnCompanionPublisher</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Lucairn directory companion (see the package README).</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LucairnCompanionPublisher</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/*
 * LucairnCompanionPublisher - builds and serves the COMPANION document of
 * this instance: the field map of its tables (classes of fields, derived
 * from the instance's own data dictionary), next to the fingerprint bundle.
 * This version publishes NO person: persons is empty, every index position
 * says "no owner published" (contract v5.1, field-map-only companion). Its
 * field_only bit marks role-word forms (fieldOnlyMarks below).
 *
 * Rule ids in the comments (PR-, B-, E-, U-, GE-, ST-, RP-, SW-, FL-, SR,
 * SM, GD-1, CS-, D-) name the rules and steps of this file's design note
 * (v3, with its addendum v3.1; "v3.1 item N" is an item of the addendum).
 * V4 in the comments marks the 60-second tick: the scheduler and its light
 * check, the periodic slot, the one accelerated run per publication.
 *
 * TRUST: the package trusts this instance as the fingerprint bundle does.
 * It reads the dictionary as its job session sees it and takes that as the
 * instance's statement of its data model; it does not prove the read
 * complete. What it guarantees is about its own code: a map comes from one
 * read that passed the snapshot rule or is not published (a change that
 * fires no rule and keeps the counts and the newest update times is the
 * stated exception); nothing is served that was not read back as written;
 * a served document belongs to the published bundle, to the settings as
 * the fetch read them at its start and to this instance; a companion
 * failure never touches the bundle path; no name of a left-out table or
 * field and no setting value leaves through status or a log.
 *
 * HOW THIS FILE IS BUILT. As the publisher: everything inside ONE outer
 * function; the class holds the entry points only (list at the end). It
 * names the generation table for READS only and never names the chunk
 * table, the key table or the publisher's state row. The tag comes from
 * the publisher's companionTag(values); this file never sees the key.
 *
 * Written in ECMAScript 5; pure ASCII.
 */
var LucairnCompanionPublisher = (function() {
    var S = 'x_1620539_lucdir';
    var K = {
        T_GENERATION: S + '_generation',        // read only
        T_STATE: S + '_cstate',
        T_HEAD: S + '_chead',
        T_PIECE: S + '_cpiece',
        P_ENABLED: S + '.enabled',
        P_COMPANION: S + '.companion_enabled',
        P_LABEL_COLUMNS: S + '.label_columns',
        P_PEOPLE_TABLES: S + '.people_tables',
        P_LEAVE_OUT: S + '.leave_out',
        P_INSTANCE_ID: S + '.instance_id',
        ROLE_READER: S + '.reader',
        JOB_NAME: 'Lucairn directory: publish companion'
    };
    var STORE_TABLES = [['cstate', S + '_cstate'], ['chead', S + '_chead'], ['cpiece', S + '_cpiece']];
    /* The columns each companion table's conditional updates and deletes query on (every addQuery on the three
     * tables; sys_id is a system column that cannot be dropped and is not listed). The platform ignores a query on
     * an unknown column, so a missing one would turn a conditional write into a write of every row. */
    var CONDITION_COLUMNS = { cstate: ['lease_token', 'state', 'for_attempt'], chead: ['state', 'revision', 'owner_token'], cpiece: ['revision'] };
    /* V4: the two bookkeeping columns of the scheduler. Not queried on, but a store without them could not record a
     * periodic slot or an accelerated run, so the guard asks for them as well. */
    var MARKER_COLUMNS = { cstate: ['last_periodic_slot', 'accel_pub_id'], chead: [], cpiece: [] };
    var STORE_INCLUDES = ['LucairnCompanionBytes', 'LucairnFieldMapDerivation', 'LucairnCompanionPublisher'];

    // ---- constants (all initial, section 15; B1b measures them) ----------
    var PIECE_SIZE = 32000;
    var LEASE_SECONDS = 3600;
    var TIME_BUDGET_SECONDS = 1800;
    var PERIOD_SECONDS = 900;               // V4: the fixed clock slot of the periodic full run
    var LEASE_MARGIN_SECONDS = 300;
    var RETRY_SECONDS = 3600;
    var REBUILD_AGE_SECONDS = 86400;
    var MAX_AGE_SECONDS = 172800;
    var FUTURE_SECONDS = 300;
    var FAILED_KEEP_SECONDS = 86400;
    var MAX_FAILURES = 3;
    var MAX_STOPS = 3;
    var MAX_DICTIONARY_ROWS = 200000;
    var MAX_TABLE_ROWS = 20000;
    var MAX_FINGERPRINTS = 110000;
    var MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARS = 4000000;
    var MAX_SETTING_CHARS = 4000;
    var MAX_LEASE_TOKEN_CHARS = 40;
    var DETAIL_LIMIT = 1900;
    var ROWS_PER_TIME_CHECK = 10000;
    var CALLS_PER_TIME_CHECK = 1000;
    var MAX_ABOVE = 32;
    var DESCRIPTOR_CHECK = false;
    var FETCH_DIGEST = false;
    var DOMAIN_PLUGIN_ID = '';
    var MAX_SAFE = 9007199254740991;

    // ---- closed sets of words (6.4); a word of another module is used only if it is a MEMBER ----
    function setOf(list) {
        var o = {}, i;
        for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) o[list[i]] = true;
        return o;
    }
    var ENGINE_WORDS = setOf(['engine:number_join', 'engine:number_text', 'engine:default_sort', 'engine:key_sort',
        'engine:string_compare', 'engine:escape', 'engine:arithmetic', 'engine:serialise', 'engine:exception']);
    var DERIVE_FATAL = setOf(['input_not_readable', 'user_table_missing', 'user_table_unreadable',
        'label_column_unusable', 'people_check_failed']);
    var DERIVE_DETAIL = setOf(['dictionaryRows', 'tableRows', 'exception', 'too_many_copied_entries', 'map_not_readable',
        'people_field_fixed', 'people_field_column_mismatch', 'people_field_free_is_a_label_column',
        'people_field_text_is_a_label_column', 'identity_column_not_on_a_people_table', 'people_field_not_hide_class',
        'possible_people_table_has_super', 'possible_people_field_not_hide_class', 'super_is_possible_people_or_left_out']);
    var SERIALISE_WORDS = setOf(['bundle_set_digest', 'counts', 'digest', 'fingerprint_not_a_string',
        'fingerprint_not_lower_hex', 'fingerprint_width', 'fingerprints_not_a_list', 'fingerprints_not_sorted',
        'index_input', 'instance_id', 'key_not_ascii', 'key_reserved', 'not_an_integer', 'parts_keys', 'person_count',
        'row_column', 'row_field_only', 'row_kind', 'row_missing', 'row_person', 'row_shape', 'row_without_fingerprint',
        'sha256_missing', 'sha256_shape', 'tag_input_shape', 'too_deep', 'unsupported_value']);
    var SHAPE_WORDS = setOf(['malformed_document', 'format_mismatch', 'version_mismatch', 'label_generation_out_of_range',
        'index_length_mismatch', 'count_mismatch']);
    var TAG_WORDS = setOf(['off', 'key_store_open', 'bad_values', 'generation_not_published', 'key_changed', 'tag_failed']);
    var SEVEN = ['name', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'user_name', 'email', 'phone', 'mobile_phone'];
    var CLASS_WORDS = setOf(['birth', 'code', 'fixed', 'free', 'identity', 'ref_user', 'text']);
    var UNLISTED_WORDS = setOf(['birth_name_not_a_date', 'chain_conflict', 'duplicate_conflict', 'field_name_not_carried',
        'inactive_row', 'label_column_wrong_type', 'left_out_by_admin', 'parent_unreadable', 'people_table_default',
        'possible_people_table', 'reference_not_user', 'reference_without_target', 'string', 'table_name_not_carried',
        'table_not_in_list', 'type_not_named']);
    var SKIPPED_WORDS = setOf(['collection_row', 'duplicate_same', 'row_not_readable']);
    var REFUSAL_LISTS = setOf(['label_column', 'people_table', 'leave_out', 'leave_out_field']);
    var REFUSAL_WORDS = setOf(['bad_name', 'has_digit', 'listed_twice', 'one_of_the_seven', 'system_field',
        'refused_word', 'not_a_user_family_field', 'wrong_type', 'too_many', 'in_user_family', 'not_in_table_list',
        'parent_unreadable', 'shared_parent', 'covered_by_accepted_parent', 'people_table', 'entry_above_only',
        'entry_above']);
    var NORMALISED = { label_column: setOf(['listed_twice', 'one_of_the_seven']),
        people_table: setOf(['listed_twice', 'in_user_family', 'covered_by_accepted_parent']),
        leave_out: setOf(['listed_twice']), leave_out_field: setOf(['listed_twice']) };
    var TICK_WORDS = setOf(['off', 'companion_off', 'companion_store_open', 'state_row_created', 'state_row_not_single',
        'state_row_invalid', 'nothing_published', 'head_unreadable', 'instance_id_changed', 'publication_expiry_invalid',
        'publication_expired', 'fingerprints_too_many', 'settings_too_long', 'settings_not_ascii', 'build_running',
        'companion_build_failed', 'companion_halted', 'current', 'waiting', 'built', 'failed', 'unexpected',
        'light_idle', 'not_accelerated',
        'engine:number_join', 'engine:number_text', 'engine:default_sort', 'engine:key_sort', 'engine:string_compare',
        'engine:escape', 'engine:arithmetic', 'engine:serialise', 'engine:exception']);
    var PASS = setOf(['fixed', 'code']);
    var HIDE = setOf(['identity', 'ref_user', 'birth']);
    var STATES = setOf(['idle', 'building', 'failed', 'stopped']);
    var HEAD_FIELDS = ['revision', 'state', 'reason', 'owner_token', 'owner_lease_until', 'built_at', 'read_at', 'pub_id',
        'settings_digest', 'origin', 'tables', 'mapped_fields', 'digest', 'tag', 'total_chars', 'piece_count'];
    var STATE_FIELDS = ['state', 'dirty', 'lease_until', 'lease_token', 'for_attempt', 'failures', 'stops', 'stopped_at',
        'last_attempt_at', 'last_reason', 'last_step', 'detail', 'last_periodic_slot', 'accel_pub_id'];

    var RE_DEC = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,15})$/;
    var RE_HEX64 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
    var RE_HEX32 = /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/;
    var RE_INSTANCE_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/;
    var RE_NOT_SETTING = /[^\x20-\x7E]/;
    var RE_FIELD_PART = /^[a-z0-9_]{1,80}$/;
    var RE_EDGE_SPACE = /^[ ]+|[ ]+$/g;
    var DOC_START = '{"field_map":';

    // ---- the package's own marked error ---------------------------------
    function Stop(word) {
        this.word = word;
    }
    function stop(word) {
        throw new Stop(word);
    }

    // ---- small helpers ----------------------------------------------------
    function own(o, k) {
        return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(o, k);
    }
    /* A-1: the ONE conversion of a platform value. */
    function text(v) {
        return v === null || v === undefined ? '' : String(v);
    }
    function isOn(name) {
        return text(gs.getProperty(name, 'false')) === 'true';
    }
    function isTrue(v) {
        return v === '1' || v === 'true';
    }
    function now() {
        return Math.floor(new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() / 1000);
    }
    function ms() {
        return new Date().getTime();
    }
    /* DEC: a stored decimal text -> its number, else null. */
    function dec(x) {
        var n;
        if (typeof x !== 'string' || !RE_DEC.test(x)) return null;
        n = parseInt(x, 10);
        return n <= MAX_SAFE ? n : null;
    }
    /* WH: a whole number in lo .. hi, not negative zero. */
    function whole(v, lo, hi) {
        return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) && Math.floor(v) === v && !(v === 0 && 1 / v < 0) && v >= lo && v <= hi;
    }
    function isPlain(v) {
        return v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Object]';
    }
    function sha256(t) {
        var h = text(new GlideDigest().getSHA256Hex(t)).toLowerCase();
        if (!RE_HEX64.test(h)) stop('digest_failed');
        return h;
    }
    function lenText(t) {
        return t.length + '\n' + t + '\n';
    }
    function compareText(a, b) {
        return a < b ? -1 : (a > b ? 1 : 0);
    }
    function count(table, encoded) {
        var a = new GlideAggregate(table), n;
        if (encoded) a.addEncodedQuery(encoded);
        a.addAggregate('COUNT');
        a.query();
        if (!a.next()) return null;
        n = dec(text(a.getAggregate('COUNT')));
        return n;
    }

    // ---- settings, origin, identity (D-11, D-23, D-25) ---------------------
    function instanceId() {
        var id = text(gs.getProperty(K.P_INSTANCE_ID, ''));
        return id !== '' ? id : text(gs.getProperty('instance_name', ''));
    }

    /* D-11: the three lists, read by three consecutive calls at ONE point. */
    function settingsSnapshot() {
        var L = text(gs.getProperty(K.P_LABEL_COLUMNS, '')), P = text(gs.getProperty(K.P_PEOPLE_TABLES, '')),
            O = text(gs.getProperty(K.P_LEAVE_OUT, ''));
        if (L.length > MAX_SETTING_CHARS || P.length > MAX_SETTING_CHARS || O.length > MAX_SETTING_CHARS)
            return { word: 'settings_too_long' };
        if (RE_NOT_SETTING.test(L) || RE_NOT_SETTING.test(P) || RE_NOT_SETTING.test(O)) return { word: 'settings_not_ascii' };
        return { L: L, P: P, O: O, digest: sha256('lucairn-companion-settings/1\n' + lenText(L) + lenText(P) + lenText(O)) };
    }

    /* D-25: one digest of the instance's name and address, read once. */
    function origin() {
        return sha256('lucairn-companion-origin/1\n' + lenText(text(gs.getProperty('instance_name', ''))) +
            lenText(text(gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri', ''))));
    }

    /* D-23: the update time of the ONE property row of the companion switch, or ''. */
    function switchStamp() {
        var p = new GlideRecord('sys_properties'), n = 0, v = '';
        p.addQuery('name', K.P_COMPANION);
        p.setLimit(2);
        p.query();
        while (p.next()) {
            n++;
            v = text(p.getValue('sys_updated_on'));
        }
        return n === 1 ? v : '';
    }

    function attemptIdentity(pubId, settingsDigest, stamp) {
        return sha256('lucairn-companion-attempt/2\n' + pubId + '\n' + settingsDigest + '\n' + stamp + '\n');
    }

    // ---- the published head (D-1, D-2, D-2a; PR-8, GE-8) ------------------
    /* The published row read ONCE into plain values, then TY. Returns
     * {H, pubId, headText} or {word}. */
    function capture(t) {
        var g = new GlideRecord(K.T_GENERATION), row, H, c, e;
        g.addQuery('state', 'published');
        g.orderByDesc('generation');
        g.setLimit(1);
        g.query();
        if (!g.next()) return { word: 'nothing_published' };
        row = { generation: text(g.getValue('generation')), fingerprint_count: text(g.getValue('fingerprint_count')),
            head: text(g.getValue('head')) };
        try {
            H = JSON.parse(row.head);
        } catch (x) {
            return { word: 'head_unreadable' };
        }
        if (!isPlain(H) || typeof H.instance_id !== 'string' || !RE_INSTANCE_ID.test(H.instance_id)) return { word: 'head_unreadable' };
        if (H.instance_id !== instanceId()) return { word: 'instance_id_changed' };
        if (!whole(H.generation, 1, MAX_SAFE) || dec(row.generation) !== H.generation) return { word: 'head_unreadable' };
        if (!whole(H.canonical_form_version, 0, MAX_SAFE)) return { word: 'head_unreadable' };
        if (typeof H.set_digest !== 'string' || !RE_HEX64.test(H.set_digest)) return { word: 'head_unreadable' };
        c = H.counts;
        if (!isPlain(c) || !whole(c.fingerprints, 1, MAX_SAFE)) return { word: 'head_unreadable' };
        if (c.fingerprints > MAX_FINGERPRINTS) return { word: 'fingerprints_too_many' };
        if (dec(row.fingerprint_count) !== c.fingerprints) return { word: 'head_unreadable' };
        e = H.expires_at;
        if (!whole(e, 0, MAX_SAFE)) return { word: 'head_unreadable' };
        if (e < 1000000000 || e > 10000000000 || e - t > 34560000) return { word: 'publication_expiry_invalid' };
        if (t >= e) return { word: 'publication_expired' };
        return { H: { instance_id: H.instance_id, generation: H.generation, canonical_form_version: H.canonical_form_version,
            set_digest: H.set_digest, fingerprints: c.fingerprints, expires_at: e }, pubId: sha256(row.head) };
    }

    /* The head text now, hashed (B-15). */
    function publishedHeadId() {
        var g = new GlideRecord(K.T_GENERATION), head;
        g.addQuery('state', 'published');
        g.orderByDesc('generation');
        g.setLimit(1);
        g.query();
        if (!g.next()) return '';
        head = text(g.getValue('head'));
        return sha256(head);
    }

    // ---- the companion store guard (GD-1) ----------------------------------
    function storeReport() {
        var off = function(v) { return v === '0' || v === 'false'; }, out = { tables: {}, script_includes: {},
            acl_table_readable: false, access_rules: {}, default_deny: false, closed: false }, i, t, n, ok = true, word;
        for (i = 0; i < STORE_TABLES.length; i++) {
            t = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object');
            t.addQuery('name', STORE_TABLES[i][1]);
            t.setLimit(2);
            t.query();
            n = 0;
            word = 'missing';
            while (t.next()) {
                n++;
                word = off(text(t.getValue('ws_access'))) && text(t.getValue('access')) === 'package_private' &&
                    off(text(t.getValue('read_access'))) && off(text(t.getValue('create_access'))) &&
                    off(text(t.getValue('update_access'))) && off(text(t.getValue('delete_access'))) &&
                    off(text(t.getValue('alter_access'))) ? 'ok' : 'not_closed';
            }
            if (n > 1) word = 'not_single';
            if (word === 'ok' && !columnsValid(STORE_TABLES[i][1],
                    CONDITION_COLUMNS[STORE_TABLES[i][0]].concat(MARKER_COLUMNS[STORE_TABLES[i][0]]))) word = 'column_missing';
            out.tables[STORE_TABLES[i][0]] = word;
            if (word !== 'ok') ok = false;
        }
        for (i = 0; i < STORE_INCLUDES.length; i++) {
            word = includeState(S + '.' + STORE_INCLUDES[i]);
            out.script_includes[STORE_INCLUDES[i]] = word;
            if (word !== 'ok') ok = false;
        }
        n = count('sys_security_acl', 'name=sys_user');
        out.acl_table_readable = n !== null && n > 0;
        for (i = 0; i < STORE_TABLES.length; i++) {
            n = count('sys_security_acl', 'name=' + STORE_TABLES[i][1] + '^ORnameSTARTSWITH' + STORE_TABLES[i][1] + '.');
            out.access_rules[STORE_TABLES[i][0]] = n;
            if (n !== 0) ok = false;
        }
        out.default_deny = text(gs.getProperty('glide.sm.default_mode', '')) === 'deny';
        out.closed = ok && out.acl_table_readable && out.default_deny;
        return out;
    }

    function includeState(apiName) {
        var s = new GlideRecord('sys_script_include'), n = 0, active = false, priv = false;
        s.addQuery('api_name', apiName);
        s.setLimit(2);
        s.query();
        while (s.next()) {
            n++;
            active = isTrue(text(s.getValue('active')));
            priv = text(s.getValue('access')) === 'package_private';
        }
        if (n === 0) return 'missing';
        if (n !== 1) return 'not_single';
        if (!active) return 'inactive';
        return priv ? 'ok' : 'not_scope_private';
    }

    function storeClosed() {
        return storeReport().closed === true;
    }

    // ---- the state row T (5.1, TV) -----------------------------------------
    function stateRows() {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(K.T_STATE), rows = [], o, i;
        gr.setLimit(2);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            o = { sys_id: text(gr.getUniqueValue()) };
            for (i = 0; i < STATE_FIELDS.length; i++) o[STATE_FIELDS[i]] = text(gr.getValue(STATE_FIELDS[i]));
            rows.push(o);
        }
        return rows;
    }

    /* TV, with the consistency of state and counters (v3.1 item 7). */
    function stateValid(T) {
        var f = dec(T.failures), s = dec(T.stops);
        if (!own(STATES, T.state)) return false;
        if (dec(T.lease_until) === null || dec(T.stopped_at) === null || dec(T.last_attempt_at) === null) return false;
        if (f === null || f > MAX_FAILURES || s === null || s > MAX_STOPS) return false;
        if (T.lease_token.length < 1 || T.lease_token.length > MAX_LEASE_TOKEN_CHARS) return false;
        if (T.for_attempt !== '' && !RE_HEX64.test(T.for_attempt)) return false;
        if ((T.state === 'stopped') !== (f === MAX_FAILURES)) return false;
        if (T.state === 'stopped' && s < 1) return false;
        return true;
    }

    function readT(sysId) {
        var rows = stateRows(), i;
        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) if (rows[i].sys_id === sysId) return rows[i];
        return null;
    }

    /* ONE conditional update of the state row: only where it still holds
     * `token` (and the further conditions). Writes the named fields only. */
    function writeT(sysId, token, values, also) {
        var u = new GlideRecord(K.T_STATE), k;
        u.addQuery('sys_id', sysId);
        u.addQuery('lease_token', token);
        if (also) for (k in also) if (own(also, k)) u.addQuery(k, also[k]);
        for (k in values) if (own(values, k)) u.setValue(k, values[k]);
        u.updateMultiple();
    }

    /* E-3a: the one creator of the state row; the tick ends after it. */
    function createStateRow() {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(K.T_STATE), id, n;
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setValue('state', 'idle');
        gr.setValue('dirty', true);
        gr.setValue('lease_until', '0');
        gr.setValue('lease_token', text(gs.generateGUID()));
        gr.setValue('for_attempt', '');
        gr.setValue('failures', 0);
        gr.setValue('stops', 0);
        gr.setValue('stopped_at', '0');
        gr.setValue('last_attempt_at', '0');
        gr.setValue('last_reason', '');
        gr.setValue('last_step', '');
        gr.setValue('detail', '');
        gr.setValue('last_periodic_slot', '');
        gr.setValue('accel_pub_id', '');
        id = text(gr.insert());
        if (id === '') return 'unexpected';
        n = stateRows().length;
        if (n === 1) return 'state_row_created';
        return n === 0 ? 'unexpected' : 'state_row_not_single';
    }

    // ---- revisions: pieces, rule U (6.3), ST-3 ---------------------------
    function headRows(state) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(K.T_HEAD), rows = [], o, i;
        if (state) gr.addQuery('state', state);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            o = { sys_id: text(gr.getUniqueValue()) };
            for (i = 0; i < HEAD_FIELDS.length; i++) o[HEAD_FIELDS[i]] = text(gr.getValue(HEAD_FIELDS[i]));
            rows.push(o);
        }
        return rows;
    }

    /* U-1: every stored value passes its typed check. */
    function typedHead(r) {
        var i, f;
        if (!RE_HEX32.test(r.revision)) return false;
        f = ['built_at', 'read_at', 'tables', 'mapped_fields', 'total_chars', 'piece_count'];
        for (i = 0; i < f.length; i++) if (dec(r[f[i]]) === null) return false;
        f = ['pub_id', 'settings_digest', 'origin', 'digest', 'tag'];
        for (i = 0; i < f.length; i++) if (!RE_HEX64.test(r[f[i]])) return false;
        return true;
    }

    function readPieces(revision) {
        var p = new GlideRecord(K.T_PIECE), out = [];
        p.addQuery('revision', revision);
        p.orderBy('seq');
        p.query();
        while (p.next()) out.push({ seq: text(p.getValue('seq')), text: text(p.getValue('text')) });
        return out;
    }

    /* ST-3: the structure of the pieces; the joined text, or null. */
    function joinPieces(pieces, pieceCount, totalChars) {
        var i, len, sum = 0, last = pieces.length - 1, parts = [], d;
        if (pieceCount < 1 || pieces.length !== pieceCount) return null;
        for (i = 0; i < pieces.length; i++) {
            if (dec(pieces[i].seq) !== i) return null;
            len = pieces[i].text.length;
            if (i < last ? len !== PIECE_SIZE : (len < 1 || len > PIECE_SIZE)) return null;
            sum += len;
            parts.push(pieces[i].text);
        }
        if (sum !== totalChars) return null;
        d = parts.join('');
        if (d.indexOf(DOC_START) !== 0 || d.substring(d.length - 2) !== '}}') return null;
        return d;
    }

    /* E-33: complete -> failed, one conditional update. */
    function markStoredMismatch(r) {
        var u = new GlideRecord(K.T_HEAD);
        u.addQuery('sys_id', r.sys_id);
        u.addQuery('state', 'complete');
        u.setValue('state', 'failed');
        u.setValue('reason', 'stored_mismatch');
        u.updateMultiple();
    }

    /* Rule U, ONE function for the tick, the fetch and the status.
     * -> { rev, text } or { none: true, wrongInstance: bool, marked: bool }. */
    function usable(pubId, settingsDigest, org, t, mayMark) {
        var rows, i, r, best = null, typed = [], wrong = false, pieces, d;
        try {
            rows = headRows('complete');
        } catch (x) {
            return { none: true, wrongInstance: false, marked: false };
        }
        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) if (typedHead(rows[i])) typed.push(rows[i]);                  // U-1
        for (i = 0; i < typed.length; i++) {
            r = typed[i];
            if (r.pub_id !== pubId || r.settings_digest !== settingsDigest) continue;                      // U-2
            if (r.origin !== org) {
                wrong = true;
                continue;
            }
            if (best === null || dec(r.built_at) > dec(best.built_at) ||
                    (dec(r.built_at) === dec(best.built_at) && compareText(r.revision, best.revision) > 0)) best = r;   // U-3
        }
        if (best === null) return { none: true, wrongInstance: wrong, marked: false };
        if (dec(best.read_at) > t + FUTURE_SECONDS || t - dec(best.read_at) > MAX_AGE_SECONDS)
            return { none: true, wrongInstance: false, marked: false, old: true };                           // U-4
        try {
            pieces = readPieces(best.revision);
        } catch (x) {
            return { none: true, wrongInstance: false, marked: false };
        }
        d = joinPieces(pieces, dec(best.piece_count), dec(best.total_chars));                             // U-6
        if (d !== null && FETCH_DIGEST && sha256(d) !== best.digest) d = null;                           // U-7
        if (d === null) {
            if (mayMark) markStoredMismatch(best);
            return { none: true, wrongInstance: false, marked: mayMark };
        }
        return { rev: best, text: d };
    }

    // ---- reap and sweep (6.6) ----------------------------------------------
    function deletePieces(revision) {
        var p = new GlideRecord(K.T_PIECE);
        p.addQuery('revision', revision);
        p.deleteMultiple();
    }

    function deleteHead(sysId) {
        var h = new GlideRecord(K.T_HEAD);
        h.addQuery('sys_id', sysId);
        h.deleteMultiple();
    }

    function headState(sysId) {
        var h = new GlideRecord(K.T_HEAD);
        h.addQuery('sys_id', sysId);
        h.setLimit(1);
        h.query();
        return h.next() ? text(h.getValue('state')) : null;
    }

    /* PD: the pieces of a head row are deleted only when the row reads as failed or is gone. */
    function failHead(sysId, revision, reason) {
        var u = new GlideRecord(K.T_HEAD), st;
        u.addQuery('sys_id', sysId);
        u.addQuery('state', 'building');
        u.setValue('state', 'failed');
        u.setValue('reason', reason);
        u.updateMultiple();
        st = headState(sysId);
        if (st === null || st === 'failed') deletePieces(revision);
    }

    /* RP-1, RP-2 and the orphan piece sweep of v3.1 item 8 (a claimed attempt, B-2). */
    function reap(t) {
        var rows = headRows('building'), ids = [], i, u, until, kept;
        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            until = dec(rows[i].owner_lease_until);
            if (until === null || until <= t) ids.push(rows[i].sys_id);
        }
        if (ids.length) {
            u = new GlideRecord(K.T_HEAD);
            u.addQuery('state', 'building');
            u.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', ids.join(','));
            u.setValue('state', 'failed');
            u.setValue('reason', 'cut_off');
            u.updateMultiple();
            for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
                if (ids.indexOf(rows[i].sys_id) < 0) continue;
                if (headState(rows[i].sys_id) === 'failed') {
                    deletePieces(rows[i].revision);
                    deleteHead(rows[i].sys_id);
                }
            }
        }
        rows = headRows('failed');
        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            kept = dec(rows[i].built_at);
            if (kept === null || kept < t - FAILED_KEEP_SECONDS) {
                deletePieces(rows[i].revision);
                deleteHead(rows[i].sys_id);
            }
        }
        sweepOrphans();
    }

    /* Pieces whose head row does not exist NOW (looked up per revision id at this moment). */
    function sweepOrphans() {
        var p = new GlideRecord(K.T_PIECE), seen = {}, list = [], i, h;
        p.query();
        while (p.next()) {
            i = text(p.getValue('revision'));
            if (!own(seen, 'r' + i)) {
                seen['r' + i] = true;
                list.push(i);
            }
        }
        for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            h = new GlideRecord(K.T_HEAD);
            h.addQuery('revision', list[i]);
            h.setLimit(1);
            h.query();
            if (!h.next()) deletePieces(list[i]);
        }
    }

    /* SW-1, run by the tick that completed R. */
    function sweep(R) {
        var rows = headRows(null), i, r, b = dec(R.built_at), rb;
        for (i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            r = rows[i];
            if (r.sys_id === R.sys_id || (r.state !== 'complete' && r.state !== 'failed')) continue;
            rb = dec(r.built_at);
            if (rb === null || rb < b || (rb === b && r.pub_id === R.pub_id && compareText(r.revision, R.revision) < 0)) {
                deletePieces(r.revision);
                deleteHead(r.sys_id);
            }
        }
    }

    // ---- the read: boundary adapter (7.1 - 7.4) -------------------------
    var TABLE_COLUMNS = ['sys_id', 'name', 'super_class'];
    var DICTIONARY_COLUMNS = ['name', 'element', 'internal_type', 'reference', 'active'];

    /* D-10. With budgets (B-4): BU on the two counts BEFORE any row is read, also the one row of the update times. */
    function marker(budgets) {
        var cd = count('sys_dictionary', ''), ct = count('sys_db_object', '');
        if (cd === null || ct === null) stop('marker_unreadable');
        if (budgets) {
            if (ct > MAX_TABLE_ROWS) stop('tables_too_large');
            if (cd > MAX_DICTIONARY_ROWS) stop('dictionary_too_large');
        }
        return { cd: cd, ct: ct, ud: newest('sys_dictionary'), ut: newest('sys_db_object') };
    }
    function markerText(m) {
        return 'd' + m.cd + ':' + m.ud + '|t' + m.ct + ':' + m.ut;
    }
    function newest(table) {
        var g = new GlideRecord(table);
        g.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
        g.setLimit(1);
        g.query();
        return g.next() ? text(g.getValue('sys_updated_on')) : '';
    }

    function columnsValid(table, columns) {
        var g = new GlideRecord(table), i;
        for (i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) if (!g.isValidField(columns[i])) return false;
        return true;
    }

    /* A-1 ... A-6: plain strings, every row, platform order. */
    function readTables(budget) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object'), rows = [];
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) {
            rows.push({ sys_id: text(g.getUniqueValue()), name: text(g.getValue('name')), super_class: text(g.getValue('super_class')) });
            if (rows.length % ROWS_PER_TIME_CHECK === 0) budget();
        }
        return rows;
    }
    function readDictionary(budget) {
        var g = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary'), rows = [];
        g.query();
        while (g.next()) {
            rows.push({ name: text(g.getValue('name')), element: text(g.getValue('element')),
                internal_type: text(g.getValue('internal_type')), reference: text(g.getValue('reference')),
                active: text(g.getValue('active')) });
            if (rows.length % ROWS_PER_TIME_CHECK === 0) budget();
        }
        return rows;
    }

    /* A-7: three smoke rows. */
    function smokeRowsHold(dictionary, tables) {
        var i, r, manager = 0, sid = 0, user = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < dictionary.length; i++) {
            r = dictionary[i];
            if (r.name !== 'sys_user') continue;
            if (r.element === 'manager') {
                if (r.internal_type !== 'reference' || r.reference !== 'sys_user') return false;
                manager++;
            } else if (r.element === 'sys_id') {
                if (r.internal_type !== 'GUID') return false;
                sid++;
            }
        }
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
            r = tables[i];
            if (r.name !== 'sys_user') continue;
            if (!RE_HEX32.test(r.sys_id) || (r.super_class !== '' && !RE_HEX32.test(r.super_class))) return false;
            user++;
        }
        return manager > 0 && sid > 0 && user > 0;
    }

    // ---- forms marked field_only (role words) -----
    /* A stored form that equals a role word is hidden in a
     * person field and is not matched by the fingerprint search in normal text. The install reads the mark from
     * index.field_only. Rule:
     * a form is marked when its canonical form equals the canonical form of a word of the short list ROLE_WORDS
     * below (out-of-box account and ITSM role words, one reason each) - and of nothing else.
     * Never a value of a per-user field (title, first or last name, ...): such a value could name a colleague.
     * Never a name of a group (sys_user_group), role (sys_user_role) or department (cmn_department) either:
     * every stored form IS a person's form (formsForUser: display name, login, e-mail part, ...),
     * so a name of those tables could only ever mark a form by being named exactly like a person's form - and a
     * group named "Anna Schmidt" would then stop the search for Anna in normal text. Skipping each table name that
     * equals an enrolled form leaves no table name that marks anything, so the tables are not read at all.
     * The publisher's companionMarks leaves out every text whose canonical form holds an '@' or no letter a-z, so
     * no e-mail form and no phone form written without letters is ever marked. Any other kind of form can be: a login, a name, the part of an
     * e-mail before '@' (the measured damage was the login 'employee'). The positions come from companionMarks:
     * this file sends texts and gets ranks, it never sees a key or a fingerprint. At most MAX_MARK_WORDS texts are
     * sent (the rest is left out and counted as 'capped'). A refused or malformed answer marks
     * nothing. Each of these gives fewer marks than the rule: the form stays found in normal text, as without the
     * marks. Only counts and a reason word go into the state row's detail, never a name. */
    var ROLE_WORDS = [
        'employee',              // out-of-box demo login 'employee'; measured: employee_type -> [PERSON_4]_type (S2-09)
        'admin',                 // out-of-box login and role 'admin' (the login itself is never enrolled; its e-mail part can be)
        'administrator',         // a usual name of an administrator account (another account than the built-in 'admin')
        'system administrator',  // the out-of-box display name of the login 'admin', when another account carries it
        'itil',                  // out-of-box role and demo login 'itil'; measured: a hit inside a tool description
        'itil user',             // out-of-box display name of the demo login 'itil'
        'service desk',          // out-of-box group and the display name of a service account
        'servicedesk',           // the same written as one word, a common login of that account
        'help desk',             // a common name of the same group or account
        'helpdesk',              // the same written as one word
        'incident manager',      // ITSM role written as a display name
        'problem manager',       // ITSM role written as a display name
        'change manager',        // ITSM role written as a display name
        'survey user',           // out-of-box demo account
        'guest',                 // out-of-box login 'guest' (never enrolled; its e-mail part can be)
        'system',                // out-of-box login 'system' (never enrolled; its e-mail part can be)
        'maint',                 // out-of-box login 'maint' (never enrolled; its e-mail part can be)
        'integration user'       // the usual display name of an integration (machine) account
    ];
    var MAX_MARK_WORDS = 5000;          // the texts sent to companionMarks (fewer marks, never more)
    var MARK_WORDS = setOf(['off', 'key_store_open', 'bad_values', 'generation_not_published', 'store_incomplete', 'key_changed',
        'generation_mismatch', 'marks_failed', 'marks_unavailable', 'marks_shape']);     // generation_mismatch: the generation binding (marksHold)

    /* The marked positions as an object {position: true}; det.marks gets the counts or the reason word. */
    function fieldOnlyMarks(H, budget, det) {
        var words = [], seen = {}, counts = { list: 0, capped: 0 }, i, p, a, marks = {}, pos, last = -1;
        for (i = 0; i < ROLE_WORDS.length; i++) {
            if (ROLE_WORDS[i] === '' || own(seen, 'k' + ROLE_WORDS[i])) continue;
            seen['k' + ROLE_WORDS[i]] = true;
            if (words.length >= MAX_MARK_WORDS) { counts.capped++; continue; }
            words.push(ROLE_WORDS[i]);
            counts.list++;
        }
        budget();
        try {
            p = new LucairnDirectoryPublisher();
            if (typeof p.companionMarks !== 'function') throw new Error('absent');
        } catch (x) {
            det.marks = 'marks_unavailable';
            return {};
        }
        try {
            a = p.companionMarks({ generation: H.generation, words: words });
        } catch (x) {
            det.marks = 'marks_failed';
            return {};
        }
        if (!isPlain(a) || a.ok !== true) {
            det.marks = isPlain(a) && typeof a.reason === 'string' && own(MARK_WORDS, a.reason) ? a.reason : 'marks_shape';
            return {};
        }
        pos = a.positions;
        if (Object.prototype.toString.call(pos) !== '[object Array]' || pos.length > H.fingerprints) {
            det.marks = 'marks_shape';
            return {};
        }
        for (i = 0; i < pos.length; i++) {
            if (!whole(pos[i], last + 1, H.fingerprints - 1)) {
                det.marks = 'marks_shape';
                return {};
            }
            last = pos[i];
            marks[pos[i]] = true;
        }
        counts.marked = pos.length;
        det.marks = counts;
        return marks;
    }

    /* True when the marks may stay - none to keep, or the publisher, asked
     * AGAIN now, gives the same positions. Its companionMarks re-reads the live name forms, recomputes their keyed
     * value with the same helper under the same key, compares it to the stored one, and checks the directory again.
     * A refusal, an error or other positions: false (the caller then drops ALL marks: fewer, never more). */
    function marksHold(H, marks, budget) {
        var again, k, n = 0;
        for (k in marks) if (own(marks, k)) n++;
        if (n === 0) return true;
        again = fieldOnlyMarks(H, budget, {});
        for (k in again) if (own(again, k) && !own(marks, k)) return false;
        for (k in marks) if (own(marks, k) && !own(again, k)) return false;
        return true;
    }

    // ---- the descriptor check (7.5; ships OFF) --------------------------
    function descriptorColumns(table) {
        var g = new GlideRecord(table), list = g.getElements(), out = {}, i, n = 0, name;
        for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            name = text(list[i].getName());
            if (name !== '' && !own(out, name)) {
                out[name] = true;
                n++;
            }
        }
        return n > 0 ? out : null;
    }

    function descriptorCheck(fieldMap, dictionary, tables, budget, det) {
        var nameOf = {}, parentOf = {}, rowsOf = {}, i, t, f, e, eset, dset, equal, k, up, steps, entry, checked = 0, mismatch = 0, calls = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) nameOf['i' + tables[i].sys_id] = tables[i].name;
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
            if (tables[i].super_class !== '' && own(nameOf, 'i' + tables[i].super_class))
                parentOf['n' + tables[i].name] = nameOf['i' + tables[i].super_class];
        }
        for (i = 0; i < dictionary.length; i++) {
            if (dictionary[i].element === '') continue;
            if (!own(rowsOf, 'n' + dictionary[i].name)) rowsOf['n' + dictionary[i].name] = [];
            rowsOf['n' + dictionary[i].name].push(dictionary[i].element);
        }
        for (t in fieldMap) {
            if (!own(fieldMap, t)) continue;
            e = fieldMap[t].fields;
            k = false;
            for (f in e) if (own(e, f) && own(PASS, e[f][0])) k = true;
            if (!k) continue;                                                  // DS-1
            checked++;
            eset = {};
            for (up = t, steps = 0; up !== undefined && steps <= MAX_ABOVE; up = parentOf['n' + up], steps++) {
                if (own(rowsOf, 'n' + up)) for (i = 0; i < rowsOf['n' + up].length; i++) eset[rowsOf['n' + up][i]] = true;
            }
            try {
                dset = descriptorColumns(t);
            } catch (x) {
                dset = null;
            }
            if (++calls % CALLS_PER_TIME_CHECK === 0) budget();
            equal = dset !== null;
            if (equal) {
                for (k in eset) if (own(eset, k) && !own(dset, k)) equal = false;
                for (k in dset) if (own(dset, k) && !own(eset, k)) equal = false;
            }
            if (equal) continue;
            mismatch++;                                                        // DS-3
            for (f in e) {
                if (!own(e, f) || !own(PASS, e[f][0])) continue;
                entry = entryAbove(fieldMap, t, f);
                if (entry !== null && own(PASS, entry[0])) e[f] = ['free', null];
                else delete e[f];
            }
        }
        det.descriptor_checked = checked;
        det.descriptor_mismatch = mismatch;
    }

    /* The nearest entry for field f on a table ABOVE t in the map, or null. */
    function entryAbove(fieldMap, t, f) {
        var up = fieldMap[t]['super'], steps = 0;
        while (up !== null && up !== undefined && own(fieldMap, up) && steps < MAX_ABOVE) {
            if (own(fieldMap[up].fields, f)) return fieldMap[up].fields[f];
            up = fieldMap[up]['super'];
            steps++;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // ---- admin lists (6.5): field entries FL, then SR -------------------
    function splitList(O) {
        var raw = O.split(','), out = { tables: [], fields: [] }, i, s;
        for (i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
            s = raw[i].replace(RE_EDGE_SPACE, '');
            if (s === '') continue;
            if (s.indexOf('.') < 0) out.tables.push(s);
            else out.fields.push(s);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /* FL-1 ... FL-8 against the map after B-7a, all before any removal. */
    function judgeFieldEntries(entries, fieldMap, tables, having) {
        var names = {}, peopleHaving = {}, seen = {}, out = [], i, s, dot, T, F, word, above;
        for (i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) names['n' + tables[i].name] = true;
        for (i = 0; i < having.length; i++) peopleHaving['n' + having[i]] = true;
        for (i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
            s = entries[i];
            dot = s.indexOf('.');
            T = s.substring(0, dot);
            F = s.substring(dot + 1);
            word = '';
            if (s.indexOf('.', dot + 1) >= 0 || !RE_FIELD_PART.test(T) || !RE_FIELD_PART.test(F) ||
                    T === '__proto__' || T === '__parent__' || F === '__proto__' || F === '__parent__') word = 'bad_name';     // FL-1
            else if (own(seen, 'e' + s)) word = 'listed_twice';                                                         // FL-2
            else if (!own(names, 'n' + T)) word = 'not_in_table_list';                                                  // FL-3
            else if (own(peopleHaving, 'n' + T)) word = 'people_table';                                                 // FL-4
            else {
                above = own(fieldMap, T) ? entryAbove(fieldMap, T, F) : null;
                if (!own(fieldMap, T) || (!own(fieldMap[T].fields, F) && above === null)) word = 'accepted_absent';     // FL-5
                else if (!own(fieldMap[T].fields, F)) word = 'entry_above_only';                                        // FL-6
                else if (above !== null) word = 'entry_above';                                                          // FL-7
                else word = 'accepted';                                                                                 // FL-8
            }
            if (word !== 'bad_name') seen['e' + s] = true;
            out.push({ table: T, field: F, word: word });
        }
        return out;
    }

    function bump(det, list, word) {
        if (!own(det.refusals, list)) det.refusals[list] = {};
        det.refusals[list][word] = (own(det.refusals[list], word) ? det.refusals[list][word] : 0) + 1;
    }

    /* SR: every refusal must be a normalised entry (D-27); counts only, no name. */
    function settingsRefused(report, judged, det) {
        var i, r, list, word, refused = false;
        det.refusals = {};
        det.normalised = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < report.refusals.length; i++) {
            r = report.refusals[i];
            list = own(REFUSAL_LISTS, r[0]) ? r[0] : 'other';
            word = own(REFUSAL_WORDS, r[2]) ? r[2] : 'other';
            bump(det, list, word);
            if (own(NORMALISED, list) && own(NORMALISED[list], word)) det.normalised++;
            else refused = true;
        }
        for (i = 0; i < judged.length; i++) {
            word = judged[i].word;
            if (word === 'accepted' || word === 'accepted_absent') continue;
            bump(det, 'leave_out_field', word);
            if (word === 'listed_twice') det.normalised++;
            else refused = true;
        }
        return refused;
    }

    // ---- detail (CS-4): numbers and closed words only -------------------
    function pick(map, allowed) {
        var out = {}, k;
        if (!isPlain(map)) return out;
        for (k in map) if (own(map, k) && own(allowed, k) && typeof map[k] === 'number') out[k] = map[k];
        return out;
    }
    function lengthOf(v) {
        return Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Array]' ? v.length : 0;
    }
    function reportCounts(r) {
        return { rows_read: r.rows_read, tables_read: r.tables_read, tables_written: r.tables_written,
            tables_not_carried: r.tables_not_carried, entries: pick(r['entries'], CLASS_WORDS),
            unlisted: pick(r.unlisted, UNLISTED_WORDS), skipped: pick(r.skipped, SKIPPED_WORDS),
            people_having: lengthOf(r.people_having), possible_people_tables: lengthOf(r.possible_people_tables),
            tables_unreadable: lengthOf(r.tables_unreadable), tables_left_out: lengthOf(r.tables_left_out),
            label_columns: lengthOf(r.label_columns) };
    }
    function total(map) {
        var n = 0, k, v;
        for (k in map) {
            if (!own(map, k)) continue;
            v = map[k];
            n += typeof v === 'number' ? v : total(v);
        }
        return n;
    }
    function detailText(det) {
        var t = JSON.stringify(det), k;
        if (t.length <= DETAIL_LIMIT) return t;
        if (det.derive) {
            for (k in { entries: 1, unlisted: 1, skipped: 1 }) if (isPlain(det.derive[k])) det.derive[k] = total(det.derive[k]);
        }
        if (isPlain(det.refusals)) det.refusals = total(det.refusals);
        if (isPlain(det.ms)) det.ms = total(det.ms);
        t = JSON.stringify(det);
        return t.length <= DETAIL_LIMIT ? t : '{"detail":"dropped"}';
    }

    // ---- the tick (6.1) and the attempt (6.2) ---------------------------
    function result(word, reason) {
        return reason === undefined ? { result: word } : { result: word, reason: reason };
    }

    function runScheduled() {
        try {
            return schedule();
        } catch (e) {
            return caught(e);
        }
    }

    function caught(e) {
        if (e instanceof Stop && own(TICK_WORDS, e.word)) return result(e.word);
        return result('unexpected');
    }

    /* V4: the job ticks every 60 s. A tick runs the FULL entry point tick() - unchanged, from its first check - in
     * two cases only:
     *   periodic: the fixed clock slot floor(now / 900) is not the state row's last_periodic_slot (missing,
     *     unreadable, older or AHEAD all count as not equal); after the run, whatever it returned, recordSlot writes
     *     the slot. So the periodic runs keep their fixed 900-s clock slots whatever else runs.
     *   accelerated: the LIGHT check below sees a publication that no complete revision belongs to, from a clean
     *     state (state idle, failures 0, stops 0, no live lease), and no build claim yet for that publication.
     * The light check reads the two switches, the state row, the published head (its id is the same hash as
     * cap.pubId), validated by the read-only capture(), and ONE bounded existence query; before acceleration it
     * also refuses invalid settings. It writes nothing and decides nothing about usability (the periodic run does). Anything it cannot read, or does not expect, suppresses the acceleration, never the
     * periodic run. The accelerated run's own checks and its claim are in tick() and attempt(). */
    function schedule() {
        var d = lightDecision();
        if (d.result === 'periodic_due') return periodic(d.slot);
        if (d.result === 'off' || d.result === 'companion_off') return tick(null);
        if (d.result === 'accelerate') return tick({ pubId: d.pubId });
        return d;
    }

    /* The decision alone never acts on its answer, even when a periodic run or an early build is due. */
    function measureLight() {
        var t0 = ms(), d;
        try { d = lightDecision(); } catch (e) { d = caught(e); }
        return { result: d.result, ms: ms() - t0 };
    }

    function lightDecision() {
        var t = now(), slot = Math.floor(t / PERIOD_SECONDS), rows = null, T = null, cap, pubId;
        if (!isOn(K.P_ENABLED)) return result('off');
        if (!isOn(K.P_COMPANION)) return result('companion_off');
        try {
            rows = stateRows();
        } catch (x) {
            rows = null;
        }
        if (rows !== null && rows.length === 1) T = rows[0];
        if (T === null || dec(T.last_periodic_slot) !== slot) return { result: 'periodic_due', slot: slot };
        if (!cleanForAcceleration(T, t)) return result('light_idle');
        try {
            cap = capture(t);
            if (cap.word) return result('light_idle');
            pubId = cap.pubId;
            if (T.accel_pub_id === pubId || completeHeadExists(pubId)) return result('light_idle');
            if (settingsSnapshot().word) return result('light_idle');
        } catch (x) {
            return result('light_idle');
        }
        return { result: 'accelerate', pubId: pubId };
    }

    /* V4: a clean state for the one accelerated run (the same test on the light read and on the full run's read). */
    function cleanForAcceleration(T, t) {
        return stateValid(T) && T.state === 'idle' && dec(T.failures) === 0 && dec(T.stops) === 0 &&
            dec(T.lease_until) <= t && (T.accel_pub_id === '' || RE_HEX64.test(T.accel_pub_id));
    }

    /* V4: ONE bounded existence query - a complete revision header with this publication id. Header rows only. */
    function completeHeadExists(pubId) {
        var h = new GlideRecord(K.T_HEAD);
        h.addQuery('pub_id', pubId);
        h.addQuery('state', 'complete');
        h.setLimit(1);
        h.query();
        return h.next();
    }

    /* V4: the periodic run, and its slot recorded on EVERY return. */
    function periodic(slot) {
        var r;
        try {
            r = tick(null);
        } catch (e) {
            r = caught(e);
        }
        try {
            recordSlot(slot, r.result);
        } catch (x) {
            // not recorded: the next tick runs the full entry point again (never fewer runs, only more)
        }
        return r;
    }

    /* V4: ONE update of the one field last_periodic_slot on the one valid state row, conditional on its sys_id only
     * (like markDirty: no other field, no lease is written over). Not written while either switch is off (read
     * again here) or the store is open - the full run wrote nothing there and neither does this - and not when
     * there is not exactly one valid state row: the next tick then runs the full entry point again. */
    function recordSlot(slot, word) {
        var rows, u;
        if (word === 'off' || word === 'companion_off' || word === 'companion_store_open') return;
        if (!isOn(K.P_ENABLED) || !isOn(K.P_COMPANION)) return;
        rows = stateRows();
        if (rows.length !== 1 || !stateValid(rows[0]) || dec(rows[0].last_periodic_slot) === slot) return;
        u = new GlideRecord(K.T_STATE);
        u.addQuery('sys_id', rows[0].sys_id);
        u.setValue('last_periodic_slot', String(slot));
        u.updateMultiple();
    }

    /* The full entry point (6.1). acc = null (a periodic run) or { pubId } (the accelerated run of the light check). */
    function tick(acc) {
        var t = now(), rows, T, word, cap, set, org, stamp, ident, u, trigger, fails;
        if (!isOn(K.P_ENABLED)) return result('off');                                          // PR-1
        if (!isOn(K.P_COMPANION)) return result('companion_off');                              // PR-2
        if (!storeClosed()) return result('companion_store_open');                             // PR-3
        rows = stateRows();                                                                    // PR-4
        if (acc && rows.length !== 1) return result('not_accelerated');
        if (rows.length === 0) return result(createStateRow());
        if (rows.length > 1) return result('state_row_not_single');
        T = rows[0];
        if (acc && (!cleanForAcceleration(T, t) || T.accel_pub_id === acc.pubId)) return result('not_accelerated');
        if (!stateValid(T)) return result('state_row_invalid');
        word = new LucairnCompanionBytes().engineSelfCheck();                                  // PR-6
        if (word !== '') return result(own(ENGINE_WORDS, word) ? word : 'unexpected');
        cap = capture(t);                                                                      // PR-8
        if (cap.word) return result(cap.word);
        if (acc && cap.pubId !== acc.pubId) return result('not_accelerated');                  // V4: the exact publication
        if (acc && completeHeadExists(cap.pubId)) return result('not_accelerated');             // before Rule U or any reset
        set = settingsSnapshot();                                                              // PR-9
        if (set.word) return result(set.word);
        org = origin();
        stamp = switchStamp();
        ident = attemptIdentity(cap.pubId, set.digest, stamp);                                 // PR-10
        if (dec(T.lease_until) > t) return result('build_running');                            // PR-11
        if (T.state === 'building') {                                                          // PR-12
            if (ownCompleteHead(T.lease_token)) {
                writeT(T.sys_id, T.lease_token, { state: 'idle', failures: 0, last_reason: '', last_step: '', lease_until: '0' },
                    { state: 'building' });                                                    // E-5a
            } else {
                fails = dec(T.failures) + 1;                                                   // E-5b
                writeT(T.sys_id, T.lease_token, fails >= MAX_FAILURES ?
                    { failures: fails, last_reason: 'cut_off', last_step: '', dirty: true, lease_until: '0', state: 'stopped',
                        stopped_at: String(t), stops: dec(T.stops) + 1 } :
                    { failures: fails, last_reason: 'cut_off', last_step: '', dirty: true, lease_until: '0', state: 'failed' },
                    { state: 'building' });
            }
            T = readT(T.sys_id);
            if (T === null || !stateValid(T)) return result('state_row_invalid');
            if (dec(T.lease_until) > t || T.state === 'building') return result('build_running');
        }
        if (ident !== T.for_attempt) {                                                         // PR-13, E-7
            writeT(T.sys_id, T.lease_token, { for_attempt: ident, failures: 0, stops: 0, state: 'idle', stopped_at: '0' });
            T = readT(T.sys_id);
            if (T === null || T.for_attempt !== ident) return result('build_running');
            if (dec(T.lease_until) > t || T.state === 'building') return result('build_running');
        }
        if (T.state === 'stopped') {                                                           // PR-14
            if (dec(T.stops) >= MAX_STOPS) return result('companion_halted');                  // E-8c
            if (t - dec(T.stopped_at) < RETRY_SECONDS) return result('companion_build_failed');    // E-8a
