sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1620539_lucdir.LucairnFingerprint</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Lucairn directory fingerprints (see the package README).</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>LucairnFingerprint</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/*
 * LucairnFingerprint - the instance side of the contract defined by
 * services/sanitizer/instance_fingerprint.py in the DSA repository (commit
 * recorded in vectors/SOURCE.md): canonical form version 4, HMAC-SHA-256
 * fingerprint, form shape and limits, set digest, canary, bundle tag and the
 * bundle document "lucairn-instance-fingerprint-bundle/2".
 *
 * Every table below is copied from that module's code-point lists. This
 * script holds no key and reads no record. Lengths are UTF-16 code units
 * (String.length). Shapes are counted in code points.
 */
var LucairnFingerprint = Class.create();

LucairnFingerprint.CANONICAL_FORM_VERSION = 4;
LucairnFingerprint.BUNDLE_FORMAT = 'lucairn-instance-fingerprint-bundle/2';
LucairnFingerprint.CANARY_TEXT = 'lucairn instance fingerprint canary v1';
LucairnFingerprint.SET_DIGEST_HEADER = 'lucairn-instance-fingerprint-set/1';
LucairnFingerprint.BUNDLE_TAG_HEADER = 'lucairn-instance-fingerprint-bundle-tag/1';
// Hard caps of the DSA module (validate_bundle check 2).
LucairnFingerprint.MIN_FORM_LENGTH = 3;
LucairnFingerprint.MAX_WORDS_CAP = 8;
LucairnFingerprint.MAX_GROUPS_CAP = 12;
LucairnFingerprint.MAX_EDGE_CAP = 2;
LucairnFingerprint.MAX_LEN_CAP = 256;
LucairnFingerprint.MAX_BUNDLE_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 400 * 86400;
LucairnFingerprint.MIN_KEY_BYTES = 32;

// Canonical form version 4, explicit code-point lists. Written as \u escapes ON PURPOSE: this source must stay
// pure ASCII. Measured on the test instance: with the characters typed literally, the removed set lost
// U+00AD and U+200B-U+200F on the way into the script engine and nine vectors of the DSA vector file differed.
LucairnFingerprint.RE_APOSTROPHE = /[\u2019\u2018\u02BC\u00B4\u0060]/g;                    // -> U+0027
LucairnFingerprint.RE_HYPHEN = /[\u2010\u2011\u2012\u2013\u2212]/g;                        // -> U+002D
LucairnFingerprint.RE_REMOVED = /[\u00AD\u200B\u200C\u200D\u200E\u200F\uFEFF\u034F]/g;     // removed (eight)
LucairnFingerprint.RE_MARKS = /[\u0300-\u036F]/g;                                          // removed
LucairnFingerprint.RE_TABLE_B = /[\u0131\u0142\u00F8\u0111\u00E6\u0153\u00F0\u00FE]/g;
LucairnFingerprint.TABLE_B = { '\u0131': 'i', '\u0142': 'l', '\u00F8': 'o', '\u0111': 'd', '\u00E6': 'ae',
    '\u0153': 'oe', '\u00F0': 'd', '\u00FE': 'th' };
// The frozen WHITESPACE list (29 code points). Not \s.
LucairnFingerprint.RE_WS_RUN = new RegExp('[\\u0009\\u000A\\u000B\\u000C\\u000D\\u001C\\u001D\\u001E\\u001F\\u0020' +
    '\\u0085\\u00A0\\u1680\\u2000\\u2001\\u2002\\u2003\\u2004\\u2005\\u2006\\u2007\\u2008\\u2009\\u200A\\u2028' +
    '\\u2029\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000]+', 'g');
LucairnFingerprint.RE_EDGE_SPACES = /^ +| +$/g;
LucairnFingerprint.RE_NON_ASCII = /[^\x00-\x7F]/;
LucairnFingerprint.RE_SURROGATE = /[\uD800-\uDFFF]/;
LucairnFingerprint.RE_ASCII_UPPER = /[A-Z]/;
LucairnFingerprint.RE_INSTANCE_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/;
LucairnFingerprint.RE_KEY_B64 = /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+={0,2}$/;
LucairnFingerprint.B64 = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';

LucairnFingerprint._tables = null;

LucairnFingerprint.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        if (!LucairnFingerprint._tables)
            LucairnFingerprint._tables = this._parseTables();
        this._t = LucairnFingerprint._tables;
        this._mac = null;
    },

    _parseTables: function() {
        var src = LucairnUnicodeTables, fold = {}, i, parts, entries = src.CASEFOLD.split(';');
        for (i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
            parts = entries[i].split(':');
            var cps = parts[1].split(' '), out = '', j;
            for (j = 0; j < cps.length; j++)
                out += this._fromCodePoint(parseInt(cps[j], 16));
            fold[this._fromCodePoint(parseInt(parts[0], 16))] = out;
        }
        if (entries.length !== src.CASEFOLD_ENTRIES)
            throw new Error('casefold table incomplete');
        return { fold: fold, foldRe: this._foldRegExp(entries), lnm: this._parseRanges(src.LNM), m: this._parseRanges(src.M), version: src.UNICODE_VERSION };
    },

    /* A regular expression that matches exactly the code points that have a
     * case folding (the keys of the table, which is sorted by code point):
     * surrogate pairs first, then one class of BMP ranges. The script engine
     * of the instance runs a per-character loop about a hundred times slower
     * than one native replace (measured), so step 3 is a single replace. */
    _foldRegExp: function(entries) {
        var bmp = '', pairs = {}, order = [], alt = [], i, cp, lo = -1, hi = -1, h, l;
        function u(n) { var x = n.toString(16).toUpperCase(); return '\\u' + '0000'.substring(x.length) + x; }
        function flush() { if (lo >= 0) bmp += lo === hi ? u(lo) : u(lo) + '-' + u(hi); }
        for (i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
            cp = parseInt(entries[i].split(':')[0], 16);
            if (cp < 0x10000) {
                if (cp === hi + 1) { hi = cp; continue; }
                flush();
                lo = hi = cp;
            } else {
                h = 0xD800 + ((cp - 0x10000) >> 10);
                l = 0xDC00 + ((cp - 0x10000) & 0x3FF);
                if (!pairs.hasOwnProperty(h)) { pairs[h] = ''; order.push(h); }
                pairs[h] += u(l);
            }
        }
        flush();
        for (i = 0; i < order.length; i++) alt.push(u(order[i]) + '[' + pairs[order[i]] + ']');
        alt.push('[' + bmp + ']');
        return new RegExp(alt.join('|'), 'g');
    },

    _parseRanges: function(text) {
        var items = text.split(','), lo = [], hi = [], i, p;
        for (i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
            p = items[i].split('-');
            lo.push(parseInt(p[0], 16));
            hi.push(parseInt(p.length > 1 ? p[1] : p[0], 16));
        }
        return { lo: lo, hi: hi };
    },

    _fromCodePoint: function(cp) {
        if (cp < 0x10000)
            return String.fromCharCode(cp);
        cp -= 0x10000;
        return String.fromCharCode(0xD800 + (cp >> 10), 0xDC00 + (cp & 0x3FF));
    },

    _inRanges: function(r, cp) {
        var a = 0, b = r.lo.length - 1, mid;
        while (a <= b) {
            mid = (a + b) >> 1;
            if (cp < r.lo[mid]) b = mid - 1;
            else if (cp > r.hi[mid]) a = mid + 1;
            else return true;
        }
        return false;
    },

    /* The code points of a string as an array of strings (one or two UTF-16
     * units each). A lone surrogate is returned as its own item. */
    _chars: function(text) {
        var out = [], i = 0, n = text.length, c, d;
        while (i < n) {
            c = text.charCodeAt(i);
            if (c >= 0xD800 && c <= 0xDBFF && i + 1 < n) {
                d = text.charCodeAt(i + 1);
                if (d >= 0xDC00 && d <= 0xDFFF) {
                    out.push(text.substr(i, 2));
                    i += 2;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            out.push(text.charAt(i));
            i++;
        }
        return out;
    },

    _codePoint: function(ch) {
        return ch.length === 2 ? (ch.charCodeAt(0) - 0xD800) * 0x400 + (ch.charCodeAt(1) - 0xDC00) + 0x10000 : ch.charCodeAt(0);
    },

    hasLoneSurrogate: function(text) {
        var i, c, n = text.length;
        if (!LucairnFingerprint.RE_SURROGATE.test(text)) return false;
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            c = text.charCodeAt(i);
            if (c >= 0xD800 && c <= 0xDBFF) {
                if (i + 1 < n && text.charCodeAt(i + 1) >= 0xDC00 && text.charCodeAt(i + 1) <= 0xDFFF) { i++; continue; }
                return true;
            }
            if (c >= 0xDC00 && c <= 0xDFFF)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    },

    _tableA: function(text) {
        return text.replace(LucairnFingerprint.RE_APOSTROPHE, '\'').replace(LucairnFingerprint.RE_HYPHEN, '-')
            .replace(LucairnFingerprint.RE_REMOVED, '');
    },

    /* Step 3: full Unicode case folding, one code point at a time, from the
     * generated table. */
    _casefold: function(text) {
        if (!LucairnFingerprint.RE_NON_ASCII.test(text))
            return LucairnFingerprint.RE_ASCII_UPPER.test(text) ? text.toLowerCase() : text;
        var fold = this._t.fold;
        return text.replace(this._t.foldRe, function(c) { return fold[c]; });
    },

    /* Canonical form version 4: the seven steps, in the contract's order. */
    canonicalForm: function(text) {
        var F = LucairnFingerprint, s = String(text);
        if (!F.RE_NON_ASCII.test(s))                                  // ASCII: steps 2, 4, 5 change nothing
            return s.replace(/`/g, '\'').toLowerCase().replace(F.RE_WS_RUN, ' ').replace(F.RE_EDGE_SPACES, '');
        s = this._tableA(s);                                          // 1
        s = s.normalize('NFKD');                                      // 2
        s = this._casefold(s);                                        // 3
        s = s.replace(F.RE_MARKS, '');                                // 4
        s = s.replace(F.RE_TABLE_B, function(c) { return F.TABLE_B[c]; });   // 5
        s = this._tableA(s);                                          // 6
        return s.replace(F.RE_WS_RUN, ' ').replace(F.RE_EDGE_SPACES, '');    // 7
    },

    /* Kind string of a canonical form, one letter per CODE POINT:
     * A = letter, digit or mark (L*, N*, M*), S = U+0020, O = other. */
    kinds: function(form) {
        if (!LucairnFingerprint.RE_NON_ASCII.test(form))            // ASCII: four native replaces, same result
            return form.replace(/[^0-9A-Za-z ]/g, '!').replace(/[0-9A-Za-z]/g, 'A').replace(/ /g, 'S').replace(/!/g, 'O');
        var chars = this._chars(form), out = '', i, c;
        for (i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
            c = this._codePoint(chars[i]);
            if (c < 128)
                out += (c >= 48 && c <= 57) || (c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122) ? 'A' : c === 32 ? 'S' : 'O';
            else
                out += this._inRanges(this._t.lnm, c) ? 'A' : 'O';
        }
        return out;
    },

    /* {words, groups, lead, trail} of a canonical form, or null if it has no
     * letter / digit / mark or a space before its first or after its last one. */
    formShape: function(form) {
        if (!LucairnFingerprint.RE_NON_ASCII.test(form)) {
            var lead = form.search(/[0-9A-Za-z]/);
            if (lead < 0) return null;
            var tail = /[^0-9A-Za-z]*$/.exec(form)[0];
            if ((lead > 0 && form.substring(0, lead).indexOf(' ') >= 0) || (tail !== '' && tail.indexOf(' ') >= 0))
                return null;
            return { words: form.split(' ').length, groups: form.match(/[0-9A-Za-z]+/g).length, lead: lead, trail: tail.length };
        }
        var k = this.kinds(form), first = k.indexOf('A'), last = k.lastIndexOf('A');
        if (first < 0 || k.substring(0, first).indexOf('S') >= 0 || k.substring(last + 1).indexOf('S') >= 0)
            return null;
        var m = k.match(/A+/g);
        return { words: k.split('S').length, groups: m.length, lead: first, trail: k.length - 1 - last };
    },

    startsWithMark: function(form) {
        if (form === '' || form.charCodeAt(0) < 0x300) return false;       // no mark lies below U+0300
        var chars = this._chars(form);
        return chars.length > 0 && this._inRanges(this._t.m, this._codePoint(chars[0]));
    },

    /* Why a canonical form cannot be enrolled, or null if it can. The reasons
     * mirror unreachable_forms of the DSA module, checked against the HARD
     * caps; minSingleToken is the configurable minimum for a form that is one
     * word and one group. */
    dropReason: function(form, minSingleToken, shapeOut) {
        var F = LucairnFingerprint, ascii = !F.RE_NON_ASCII.test(form);
        if (form === '') return 'empty';
        if (!ascii && this.hasLoneSurrogate(form)) return 'lone_surrogate';
        if (form.length < F.MIN_FORM_LENGTH) return 'too_short';
        // An ASCII string without A-Z or a grave accent, with single inner spaces and none at the ends, is its own canonical form.
        if (ascii ? /[A-Z`]|^ | $|  |[\t\n\x0B\f\r\x1C-\x1F]/.test(form) : this.canonicalForm(form) !== form) return 'not_canonical';
        var s = this.formShape(form);
        if (s === null) return 'no_matchable_shape';
        if (!ascii && this.startsWithMark(form)) return 'starts_with_mark';
        if (shapeOut) { shapeOut.words = s.words; shapeOut.groups = s.groups; shapeOut.lead = s.lead; shapeOut.trail = s.trail; }
        if (s.words > F.MAX_WORDS_CAP || s.groups > F.MAX_GROUPS_CAP || s.lead > F.MAX_EDGE_CAP ||
                s.trail > F.MAX_EDGE_CAP || form.length > F.MAX_LEN_CAP)
            return 'over_caps';
        if (s.words === 1 && s.groups === 1 && form.length < minSingleToken) return 'below_single_token_minimum';
        return null;
    },

    /* The exact limits a non-empty list of enrollable canonical forms needs:
     * five maxima and min_len = the SHORTEST form. */
    deriveShapeLimits: function(forms) {
        var lim = { max_words: 0, max_groups: 0, max_lead: 0, max_trail: 0, min_len: 0, max_len: 0 }, i, s, n;
        if (!forms.length) throw new Error('no forms');
        for (i = 0; i < forms.length; i++) {
            s = this.formShape(forms[i]);
            if (s === null) throw new Error('a form that cannot be matched');
            n = forms[i].length;
            if (s.words > lim.max_words) lim.max_words = s.words;
            if (s.groups > lim.max_groups) lim.max_groups = s.groups;
            if (s.lead > lim.max_lead) lim.max_lead = s.lead;
            if (s.trail > lim.max_trail) lim.max_trail = s.trail;
            if (i === 0 || n < lim.min_len) lim.min_len = n;
            if (n > lim.max_len) lim.max_len = n;
        }
        return lim;
    },

    limitsValid: function(lim) {
        var F = LucairnFingerprint;
        return lim.max_words >= 1 && lim.max_words <= F.MAX_WORDS_CAP && lim.max_groups >= 1 &&
            lim.max_groups <= F.MAX_GROUPS_CAP && lim.max_lead >= 0 && lim.max_lead <= F.MAX_EDGE_CAP &&
            lim.max_trail >= 0 && lim.max_trail <= F.MAX_EDGE_CAP && lim.min_len >= F.MIN_FORM_LENGTH &&
            lim.min_len <= lim.max_len && lim.max_len <= F.MAX_LEN_CAP;
    },

    /* The forms of the list that a matcher with these limits cannot find
     * (unreachable_forms of the DSA module). */
    unreachableForms: function(forms, lim) {
        var bad = [], i, f, s;
        for (i = 0; i < forms.length; i++) {
            f = forms[i];
            s = this.canonicalForm(f) === f && f !== '' ? this.formShape(f) : null;
            if (s === null || this.startsWithMark(f) || s.words > lim.max_words || s.groups > lim.max_groups ||
                    s.lead > lim.max_lead || s.trail > lim.max_trail || f.length < lim.min_len || f.length > lim.max_len)
                bad.push(f);
        }
        return bad;
    },

    // ---- key and fingerprint ------------------------------------------
    base64ToHex: function(b64) {
        var B = LucairnFingerprint.B64, s = String(b64).replace(/=+$/, ''), hex = '', bits = 0, acc = 0, i, v;
        for (i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            v = B.indexOf(s.charAt(i));
            if (v < 0) throw new Error('not base64');
            acc = (acc << 6) | v;
            bits += 6;
            if (bits >= 8) {
                bits -= 8;
                v = (acc >> bits) & 0xFF;
                hex += (v < 16 ? '0' : '') + v.toString(16);
                acc &= (1 << bits) - 1;
            }
        }
        return hex;
    },

    bytesToBase64: function(bytes) {
        var B = LucairnFingerprint.B64, out = '', i, a, b, c;
        for (i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 3) {
            a = bytes[i]; b = i + 1 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 1] : 0; c = i + 2 < bytes.length ? bytes[i + 2] : 0;
            out += B.charAt(a >> 2) + B.charAt(((a & 3) << 4) | (b >> 4)) +
                (i + 1 < bytes.length ? B.charAt(((b & 15) << 2) | (c >> 6)) : '=') +
                (i + 2 < bytes.length ? B.charAt(c & 63) : '=');
        }
        return out;
    },

    /* True for the base64 text of at least 32 bytes. */
    keyUsable: function(keyB64) {
        return typeof keyB64 === 'string' && keyB64.length % 4 === 0 && LucairnFingerprint.RE_KEY_B64.test(keyB64) &&
            this.base64ToHex(keyB64).length >= 2 * LucairnFingerprint.MIN_KEY_BYTES;
    },

    /* A new key: 32 bytes from the platform's secure random source
     * (GlideSecureRandomUtil.getSecureRandomInt, four bytes per call), base64. */
    generateKey: function() {
        var bytes = [], i, v;
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            v = GlideSecureRandomUtil.getSecureRandomInt();
            bytes.push((v >>> 24) & 0xFF, (v >>> 16) & 0xFF, (v >>> 8) & 0xFF, v & 0xFF);
        }
        return this.bytesToBase64(bytes);
    },

    /* HMAC-SHA-256(key, UTF-8 bytes of text) as lowercase hex. */
    macHex: function(keyB64, text) {
        if (!this._mac)     // a scoped application may only use CertificateEncryption; global scripts have the Glide name
            this._mac = typeof CertificateEncryption !== 'undefined' ? new CertificateEncryption() : new GlideCertificateEncryption();
        var hex = this.base64ToHex(String(this._mac.generateMac(keyB64, 'HmacSHA256', text)));
        if (hex.length !== 64) throw new Error('mac width');
        return hex;
    },

    /* Table for the bulk path: two base64 characters = 12 bits = three hex
     * digits; and the 43rd character of a 32-byte value = its upper 4 bits. */
    _pairTable: function() {
        var B = LucairnFingerprint.B64, H = '0123456789abcdef', pair = {}, last = {}, i, j, v;
        for (i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            last[B.charAt(i)] = H.charAt(i >> 2);
            for (j = 0; j < 64; j++) {
                v = (i << 6) | j;
                pair[B.charAt(i) + B.charAt(j)] = H.charAt(v >> 8) + H.charAt((v >> 4) & 15) + H.charAt(v & 15);
            }
        }
        return { pair: pair, last: last };
    },

    /* The same value as macHex, for many texts under one key. */
    _macHexBulk: function(keyB64, text) {
        var b64 = String(this._mac.generateMac(keyB64, 'HmacSHA256', text)), P = this._pairs.pair, i, hex = '';
        if (b64.length !== 44 || b64.charAt(43) !== '=' || b64.charAt(42) === '=') throw new Error('mac width');
        for (i = 0; i < 42; i += 2) hex += P[b64.substr(i, 2)];
        hex += this._pairs.last[b64.charAt(42)];
        if (hex.length !== 64) throw new Error('mac width');
        return hex;
    },

    canaryHex: function(keyB64) {
        return this.macHex(keyB64, LucairnFingerprint.CANARY_TEXT);
    },

    // ---- set digest, tag, document -----------------------------------
    /* SHA-256 over: header line, count line, one lowercase-hex line per
     * fingerprint in ascending order, each line ended by one line feed.
     * sortedHex must be sorted and without duplicates. */
    setDigestHex: function(sortedHex) {
        var text = LucairnFingerprint.SET_DIGEST_HEADER + '\n' + sortedHex.length + '\n' +
            (sortedHex.length ? sortedHex.join('\n') + '\n' : '');
        return String(new GlideDigest().getSHA256Hex(text)).toLowerCase();
    },

    /* The nine lines of the bundle tag input, each ended by one line feed. */
    tagInput: function(v) {
        var L = v.limits;
        if (!LucairnFingerprint.RE_INSTANCE_ID.test(v.instance_id)) throw new Error('instance_id');
        return [LucairnFingerprint.BUNDLE_TAG_HEADER,
            'instance_id=' + v.instance_id,
            'generation=' + this._int(v.generation),
            'canonical_form_version=' + this._int(v.canonical_form_version),
            'limits=' + [this._int(L.max_words), this._int(L.max_groups), this._int(L.max_lead), this._int(L.max_trail),
                this._int(L.min_len), this._int(L.max_len)].join(','),
            'canonical_forms=' + this._int(v.canonical_forms),
            'fingerprints=' + this._int(v.fingerprints),
            'expires_at=' + this._int(v.expires_at),
            'set_digest=' + v.set_digest].join('\n') + '\n';
    },

    _int: function(n) {
        if (typeof n !== 'number' || !isFinite(n) || Math.floor(n) !== n || Math.abs(n) > 9007199254740991)
            throw new Error('not an integer');
        return n.toFixed(0);
    },

    /* Everything of the bundle document but the fingerprint list, for a
     * sorted, duplicate-free list of fingerprints made with this key. */
    bundleHead: function(keyB64, instanceId, generation, limits, sortedHex, expiresAt) {
        var F = LucairnFingerprint, head = {
            format: F.BUNDLE_FORMAT,
            instance_id: instanceId,
            generation: generation,
            canonical_form_version: F.CANONICAL_FORM_VERSION,
            limits: { max_words: limits.max_words, max_groups: limits.max_groups, max_lead: limits.max_lead,
                max_trail: limits.max_trail, min_len: limits.min_len, max_len: limits.max_len },
            counts: { canonical_forms: sortedHex.length, fingerprints: sortedHex.length },
            set_digest: this.setDigestHex(sortedHex),
            expires_at: expiresAt,
            canary: this.canaryHex(keyB64)
        };
        head.tag = this.macHex(keyB64, this.tagInput({ instance_id: instanceId, generation: generation,
            canonical_form_version: F.CANONICAL_FORM_VERSION, limits: head.limits, canonical_forms: sortedHex.length,
            fingerprints: sortedHex.length, expires_at: expiresAt, set_digest: head.set_digest }));
        return head;
    },

    // ---- enrolment ------------------------------------------------------
    /* The readable forms of one user record (the enrolment policy of the
     * README). u = {user_name, first_name, last_name, name, email, phone,
     * mobile_phone}; empty values give no form. */
    formsForUser: function(u) {
        var out = [], first = u.first_name || '', last = u.last_name || '', email = u.email || '', at, f;
        function add(v) { if (v) out.push(v); }
        add(u.user_name);
        add(u.name);
        if (first && last) {
            f = first.charAt(0);
            if (first.length > 1 && first.charCodeAt(0) >= 0xD800 && first.charCodeAt(0) <= 0xDBFF &&
                    first.charCodeAt(1) >= 0xDC00 && first.charCodeAt(1) <= 0xDFFF)
                f = first.substring(0, 2);
            add(first + ' ' + last);
            add(last + ', ' + first);
            add(last + ' ' + first);
            add(f + '. ' + last);
            add(first + '.' + last);
            add(f + last);
            add(first + '_' + last);
        }
        add(email);
        at = email.indexOf('@');
        if (at > 0) add(email.substring(0, at));
        add(u.phone);
        add(u.mobile_phone);
        return out;
    },

    /* forms: readable forms. Returns the running state {map of the distinct
     * enrollable canonical forms, dropped: {reason: count}, seen, kept,
     * limits: the exact shape limits of the forms kept so far (five maxima,
     * min_len = the shortest)}. */
    enrol: function(forms, minSingleToken, state) {
        var st = state || { map: {}, dropped: {}, seen: 0, kept: 0,
            limits: { max_words: 0, max_groups: 0, max_lead: 0, max_trail: 0, min_len: 0, max_len: 0 } }, i, c, r, sh = {}, L = st.limits;
        for (i = 0; i < forms.length; i++) {
            st.seen++;
            if (this.hasLoneSurrogate(forms[i])) { st.dropped.lone_surrogate = (st.dropped.lone_surrogate || 0) + 1; continue; }
            c = this.canonicalForm(forms[i]);
            if (st.map.hasOwnProperty('k' + c)) continue;
            r = this.dropReason(c, minSingleToken, sh);
            if (r !== null) { st.dropped[r] = (st.dropped[r] || 0) + 1; continue; }
            st.map['k' + c] = true;
            if (sh.words > L.max_words) L.max_words = sh.words;
            if (sh.groups > L.max_groups) L.max_groups = sh.groups;
            if (sh.lead > L.max_lead) L.max_lead = sh.lead;
            if (sh.trail > L.max_trail) L.max_trail = sh.trail;
            if (st.kept === 0 || c.length < L.min_len) L.min_len = c.length;
            if (c.length > L.max_len) L.max_len = c.length;
            st.kept++;
        }
        return st;
    },

    enrolledForms: function(state) {
        var out = [], k;
        for (k in state.map)
            if (state.map.hasOwnProperty(k)) out.push(k.substring(1));
        return out;
    },

    /* Sorted, duplicate-free lowercase-hex fingerprints of canonical forms. */
    fingerprintAll: function(keyB64, canonicalForms) {
        var hex = [], i, out = [];
        if (canonicalForms.length && this.macHex(keyB64, canonicalForms[0]).length !== 64) throw new Error('mac width');
        if (!this._pairs) this._pairs = this._pairTable();
        for (i = 0; i < canonicalForms.length; i++)
            hex.push(this._macHexBulk(keyB64, canonicalForms[i]));
        if (canonicalForms.length && hex[0] !== this.macHex(keyB64, canonicalForms[0])) throw new Error('mac table');
        hex.sort();
        for (i = 0; i < hex.length; i++)
            if (i === 0 || hex[i] !== hex[i - 1]) out.push(hex[i]);
        return out;
    },

    type: 'LucairnFingerprint'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>lucairn.runner</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-13 01:42:07</sys_created_on><sys_id>3a33801f73fb0354ed3bfa714ab8b76a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LucairnFingerprint</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Lucairn Directory Fingerprints" source="x_1620539_lucdir">41b040d773fb0354ed3bfa714ab8b787</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Lucairn Directory Fingerprints">41b040d773fb0354ed3bfa714ab8b787</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_3a33801f73fb0354ed3bfa714ab8b76a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>lucairn.runner</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-13 08:25:40</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

    // The document is written as text, in the platform's usual {"result": ...} envelope.
    response.setContentType('application/json');
    response.getStreamWriter().writeString('{"result":' + r.text + '}');
})(request, response);
